text:
Do you know, Daphne, that old romance
beneath the sycamore… under white mulberries,
beneath the weeping olive or trembling willows,
that love song forever beginning anew?

Do you recognize the temple’s vast peristyle,
the bitter lemons whose rind you bit,
and the fatal cave of unwary guests
where the defeated serpent’s seed sleeps?

Do you know why the volcano has opened again?
One day we touched it with our nimble feet,
covering the far horizon with its dust!

Since a ship broke our clay gods,
beneath the palm of Virgil’s urn,
pale hydrangeas mingle with green laurel.

translation.title: To J.-Y. Colonna
